name: polish
title: Polish
description: Fix the selected text with any OpenAI-compatible provider and paste it back in place, plus a cleanup for text copied from a terminal.
author: leo

commands.name: fix-writing
commands.title: Fix Writing
commands.subtitle: Preview
commands.description: Fix the selected text, preview the result and press Enter to paste it in place.

commands.name: fix-writing-instant
commands.title: Fix Writing Instantly
commands.subtitle: No Preview
commands.description: Fix the selected text and replace it right away, without a preview.

commands.name: shorten-text
commands.title: Shorten Text
commands.subtitle: Key Facts Only
commands.description: Cut the selected text down to its key facts, preview it and press Enter to paste it in place.

commands.name: clean-up-text
commands.title: Clean up Text
commands.subtitle: Terminal Copy
commands.description: Remove indentation and join hard-wrapped lines of text copied from a terminal. No AI, works instantly.

preferences.name: baseUrl
preferences.title: Provider Base URL
preferences.description: Any OpenAI-compatible endpoint, e.g. https://api.openai.com/v1, https://api.deepseek.com/v1, https://openrouter.ai/api/v1, http://localhost:11434/v1

preferences.name: apiKey
preferences.title: API Key
preferences.description: API key for the provider. Leave empty for local providers like Ollama or LM Studio.

preferences.name: models
preferences.title: Models
preferences.description: Comma-separated model IDs. The first one is the default, the others show up in the preview under Change Model.

preferences.name: proxyUrl
preferences.title: Proxy URL
preferences.description: Optional HTTP proxy for networks that block direct connections. Skipped automatically when the proxy host cannot be resolved, so it keeps working on other networks. Not used for localhost providers.

preferences.name: humanWriting
preferences.title: Writing Style
preferences.label: Human writing rules
preferences.description: Also remove em dashes, AI-sounding words and filler phrases while fixing.

preferences.name: alwaysCopy
preferences.title: Clipboard
preferences.label: Also copy the result to the clipboard
preferences.description: Copy every result to the clipboard in addition to pasting it. Without this, it only copies when it cannot confirm a text field or pasting fails.

preferences.name: statusMessages
preferences.title: Status Messages
preferences.label: Show progress and success messages
preferences.description: Show the progress message while fixing and the message when the text was pasted. Errors and the clipboard fallback always show.

preferences.name: instructions
preferences.title: Extra Instructions
preferences.description: Optional rules added to the built-in prompt, e.g. 'Use Swiss German spelling (ss instead of ß). Keep it casual.'

preferences.name: instructionsFile
preferences.title: Instructions File
preferences.description: Optional .md or .txt file with longer writing rules (a style guide). Appended to the built-in prompt.
